question: For a frozen 3-by-3 family of test states on the p>0 Darboux momentum base, does the declared improved-static BFV zero-mode contraction define the same sesquilinear form as the order-zero spectral distribution delta(M_c), including an independently integrated Gaussian regulator removal?

upstream_results.role: supplies the declared dPi/(2*pi*hbar), dN/(2*pi*hbar), oriented ghost normalization and local delta(T)delta(c) contraction
supplies H_D=L2(R_c times R_{+,p},dc dp), M_c and the order-zero zero-fiber form
supplies the explicit off-shell unitary freedom that equals one on c=0 and therefore should not affect this order-zero comparison

primary_sources.source: Marolf, Refined Algebraic Quantization: Systems with a single constraint, arXiv:gr-qc/9508015
primary_sources.used_for: the distributional single-constraint zero-spectrum and auxiliary-structure boundary
primary_sources.not_used_for: deriving this local static source or its frozen normalization

primary_sources.source: Giulini, Group Averaging and Refined Algebraic Quantization, arXiv:gr-qc/0003040
primary_sources.used_for: the distinction between rigging distributions and bounded projectors
primary_sources.not_used_for: promoting a finite test-family match to a physical group average

frozen_test_family.component: c in R and p>0 only

exact_plan: hash-verify the static-source, spectral-domain and subprincipal-family results
verify the upstream source really has unit bosonic Fourier pairing and normalized oriented ghost factor +1
derive the full rational 3-by-3 static pairing matrix on p>0 and verify Hermiticity and positive definiteness
derive the same order-zero matrix by the spectral zero-fiber form of M_c
derive the exact Gaussian-regulated matrix and its epsilon to zero limit entry by entry
verify the subprincipal family equals one at c=0 and hence leaves this order-zero matrix unchanged
compare independent high-precision p and c quadratures with the exact static and regulated entries
do not insert a second delta(c), import p<0, or identify this finite test-form comparison with a full trajectory or physical group average

numerical_plan.method: nine direct p-half-line integrals plus twenty-seven direct c-line Gaussian regulator integrals

decision_table.condition: all upstream normalization pins, exact matrix identities, positivity, regulator limits and independent quadratures pass on p>0
decision_table.meaning: the one declared local static zero-mode convention realizes the same frozen order-zero form as delta(M_c); no endpoint transform, path measure or physical group average is inferred

decision_table.condition: a sign, hbar, 2*pi, ghost-orientation or matrix normalization differs
decision_table.meaning: reject the claimed bridge while preserving its independently valid inputs

decision_table.condition: the symbolic equality holds but the independent regulator integration fails
decision_table.meaning: retain only the formal matrix identity pending a reconciled regulator calculation

computed_scope: the frozen 3-by-3 static zero-mode pairing matrix for p>0 test states
the matching order-zero delta(M_c) spectral matrix
entrywise exact Gaussian regulator removal and independent high-precision integration
invariance of the shell form under the explicit off-shell subprincipal family
not_computed: a normalized exact endpoint-state transform or selected subprincipal symbol
an identity kernel in Phi on the p>0 half-line
a full-real-lapse group average, regulator theorem for arbitrary states or physical inner product
nonzero BFV trajectory modes, an absolute path measure, old-kernel equivalence or global cycle
physics, an observable prediction or a TOE claim
